journal_tone_effect.scope: three requested tones on one text against 10 same-parameter neutral repeats, engine chatterbox_turbo

journal_conversation_persistence.scope: durability of the discussion record on disk; not its return into memory
journal_conversation_persistence.proves: human, agent and embry turns are appended to conversation.jsonl under an exclusive lock, survive the browser, read back after write, and are bound by hash to the journal they discuss; an embry turn is refused unless it carries a requested delivery tone and rendered audio
journal_conversation_persistence.does_not_prove: that the conversation reaches memory or influences a later dream; that return arc is blocked on graph-memory-operator#99, where a stored document is not retrievable

daily_event_ingestion.scope: current-day code, project-state and affect events entering memory
daily_event_ingestion.does_not_prove: that successive dreams differ; the five-cycle pilot produced byte-identical journals (sha f812641f9dbbc7e2). Measured 2026-08-04, two upstream defects in the memory service: a document that /store accepts and that is present in ArangoDB is never returned by /recall, even queried with its own text (graph-memory-operator#99); and /recall does not filter by the scope it is given, returning other scopes' documents, so the five recall strata are five semantic queries over one undifferentiated pool (graph-memory-operator#100). Recall is deterministic within a scope (Jaccard 1.000 over 5 repeats), so scope perturbs ranking but restricts nothing.

journal_ux_browser_proof.scope: the static journal/chat page rendered in a real browser
journal_ux_browser_proof.proves: the page renders in Chrome at 1440x900 with journal prose, tone chips and provenance footnotes; footnote links resolve to their anchors; the audio player resolves its source and loads the journal audio at its true 17.48s duration
journal_ux_browser_proof.does_not_prove: visual design quality, other viewports, accessibility, or that a human finds it usable
